high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Elon Musk on the X platform (formerly Twitter). The tweet reads: "Ani stepped out of the hologram." Below this tweet, there is a reply from Eric Jiang (@veggie_eric) that says: "Our new Grok Imagine is a step function better than the original. Genuinely kind of mind blowing. And it's free for everyone! No invite codes needed 😄." The image attached to the tweet shows a large, rectangular display screen mounted on a wall. The screen displays an animated character with blonde hair styled in pigtails, wearing a blue dress
